name: Hagen im Bremischen (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided blue over red, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Hagen im Bremischen (a key, a star with oak leaves and a megalithic tomb).
history: Municipal flag of Hagen im Bremischen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Hagen im Bremischen arms — key, star and megalithic tomb
